name: INVENTORY_REDUCER_V1
principle: Current state is a deterministic reduction of accepted append-oriented Inventory facts. Projection rows are transactionally maintained caches and never independent editable truth.

rules: reactivate restores active key only if unique

reducers.output: draft/submitted_awaiting_response/acknowledged/partially_authorized/authorized/cancelled/rejected plus warning chronology/current effective submission snapshot
rules: response timer begins only from current-effective accepted submission
authorization is quantity-relative to immutable submitted quantity; partial remains explicit
false-submission correction clears current effective snapshot without deleting historical snapshot
latest accepted current-effective targeted facts reduce by dimension
correction supersedes targeted fact without deleting it
warehouse receipt has no closing authority
warehouse rejection/reopen preserves selected unit and open obligation

inputs: active Fault Tag membership and warehouse state
rules: partial request progress never forces sibling RMAs
accepted final warehouse decision is the only closure path
corrected false submission returns to draft only through exact correction chain

reducers.output: draft/submitted/in_warehouse_review/terminal_completed/terminal_with_rejected/cancelled/superseded, current effective submission snapshot and counts
rules: terminal only when every submitted membership final/cancelled/superseded
false-submission correction clears current effective snapshot but preserves historical snapshots

correction_order: For each reducible dimension, follow exact target_event/relationship correction chain; reject cycles/multiple competing current-effective corrections. Genuine later operational events are ordered by accepted domain chronology and recording identity, never reclassified as corrections.
commit_rule: Command appends facts and rebuilds every affected projection/attention row before commit; projection failure rolls back authoritative mutation.
